title: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina Part 2: RNA Isolation
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit
Beads added to sample and mixed
Master mix elution added to sample

steps.title: Add beads to sample
steps.instruction: Add magnetic beads to each RNA sample and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Pause for user
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol as indicated before proceeding.

steps.title: Mix samples
steps.instruction: Mix the samples to ensure beads are evenly distributed.

steps.title: Engage magnet and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module, allow beads to collect, then remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash beads twice
steps.instruction: Wash the bead‑bound RNA twice with the provided wash buffer, removing supernatant after each wash.

steps.title: Add Tris buffer
steps.instruction: Add Tris buffer to each sample.

steps.title: Pause for user
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol as indicated before the next step.

steps.title: Add binding buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add the RNA binding buffer to each sample and incubate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnet and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module, allow beads to collect, then remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Final wash
steps.instruction: Perform a final wash of the beads and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Add master mix elution
steps.instruction: Add the master mix elution reagent to each sample.

steps.title: Pause for user
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol as indicated before incubation.

steps.title: Incubate samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples as indicated (duration not specified).

steps.title: Transfer RNA to new plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the purified RNA from the current plate to a new plate.
